topics.topic: Whether runs resolves input references before handing them to functions
questions: Does runs resolve spooled-file facts into SpooledFile records before calling functions, or must functions receive every raw PortRef, scan the complete tuple first, and resolve readable references only after the FileFactsRef check?

Does `runs` pass the NodeExecution's PortRefs unchanged so `functions` can classify and refuse FileFactsRef before lookup, or does `runs` first resolve file references into SpooledFile records; and which module owns that classification and resolution?
units: 30_modules.md:Facts several modules touch, and their one owner

quotes:
49. **A facts-only reference is refused at the capture capability.** Owner
    confirmed retaining `inputs: tuple[PortRef, ...]` and explicitly refusing
    FileFactsRef, preserving the existing implementation lookup and contract
    mismatch precedence. A04 rule 7 owns the behavior; States 3–5 and State 7
    carry it to the functions capability and its prompt. No model, signature,
    readable-input behavior or store operation changes. The whole tuple is
    checked before looking up any input or reading bytes; an empty facts list
    is still facts-only, and the refusal names the smallest offending port by
    Unicode code-point order.

Record first — a function element that ran in the sandbox (its record names
resources used) and did not succeed — then run and spool, all before an equal
existing case is returned (A15 rule 5, M06); copies nothing itself: passes
the record's inputs down as references, spooled files as their SpooledFiles
(State 3, "Capture").

The executed implementation exists and its contract version, read from its own
record, is the one named; then the complete input tuple is checked for any
FileFactsRef, including an empty list, which is refused naming FileFactsRef
and the smallest offending port in Unicode code-point order before any input
value or spooled-file lookup or input-byte read; then fit of every value; every file within
`trial_fixture_bytes_max` by its facts, read from its SpooledFile through
`store.read_records`; all before any byte is copied — only
then each spooled file is copied into the content-addressed area, so a refusal
copies nothing; inputs take the port's class (A04 rule 1, A15 rule 5, M21).
judgement.why: State 6 retains the broad PortRef tuple and assigns complete-tuple classification plus subsequent readable-reference lookup to functions, while State 5 confirms that runs passes the references down and resolves none itself.
